text: 你们在草甸中寻找可带回去的标本，忽然一个巨大阴影掠过草地，吓了你们一跳。你抬头望去，看到那宽阔的翼展，猜它也许是幸存至今的巨型秃鹫。它不是秃鹫。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 630
text: Walking through the meadowland with an eye for a trophy to take back home, your group is startled by a vast shadow that glides across the grass around you. You glance up, imagining from its vast wingspan that it might be a surviving giant condor. It is not a condor.
